rationale: The agent correctly authenticated the user via email, checked the relevant order and product variants using tools, accurately identified the desired exchange (blue S v-neck polyester to red XXL crew neck cotton), computed the price difference correctly ($7.99), and used the gift card as requested. However, the agent proceeded to execute the exchange after the user replied ambiguously (“Yes? … before we officially dive in!”), which is not an explicit confirmation. Policy requires stating the exact change and obtaining explicit confirmation before any order-changing write. This write occurred without a clear, unambiguous confirmation, so the interaction does not meet the pass bar despite otherwise correct actions and information.
